page_topic_one_liner: Domain SEO — brand vs partial-match vs exact-match domains, TLD selection (.com/.ai/.io), modifier domains, rebranding with 301 migrations
differentiator_vs_generic: This is domain strategy for SEO and brand trust, NOT domain registrar checkout ads. Hero must show browser address bar comparing brand domain vs EMD with TLD badges and a 301 redirect migration arrow — NOT an LLM chat panel or keyword-stuffed domain list.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Browser chrome address bar collage — three domain variants side by side: brand.example.com (clean, accent check), partial-match brand+keyword.com (neutral), exact-match cheapkeyword.com (muted/red X) — TLD pills .com / .ai / .io below bars, no real brand names
Secondary: modifier-domain upgrade arrow — getbrand.com → brand.com with 301 redirect loop icon (Dropbox-style migration metaphor, no company names)
Tertiary: domain renewal calendar reminder strip with 90/60/30-day markers (dots only, no date text)
anti_patterns: Domain marketplace price screenshot or GoDaddy checkout as hero
Generic globe icon without address-bar domain comparison
